title: Sharp finite-horizon robustness and the escape condition needed for mean-time stability
checked_scope: Homogeneous finite-state intervention kernel; total-variation robustness of recovery probabilities and mean hitting times.
significance: Strengthens Tη to sharp 1−(1−η)^T and proves a mean-escape-time perturbation theorem under explicit uniform recovery probability.
